title: HERE IN HOLLYWOOD: Remembering Eric Bauza, the Filipino-Canadian voice who brought Bugs Bunny to life
summary: Long before he became the modern voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Tweety Bird, Marvin the Martian and many other famous cartoon characters, Eric Bauza was a young boy making his Filipino family laugh.
